# Model card: Exception message note

| | |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Write an optional personal paragraph for a drafted message to a vendor or requester about an invoice exception. |
| Workflow | pay |
| Code | `pairly_pay.exceptions` |
| Prompt | `pay_exception_note` version `v1`, file SHA-256 `bbb88021dc30eddb...` |
| Output schema | `ExceptionNote` |
| Model tiers, cheapest first | `small` (anthropic `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, openai `gpt-6-luna`) then `large` (anthropic `claude-sonnet-5-5`, openai `gpt-6.1-sol`) |
| Temperature | 0.0 |
| Output token limit | 512 |
| Confidence threshold to accept | none |

## Inputs

The template's purpose and the language only. Never the invoice, the vendor or a person.

## Outputs

`ExceptionNote`, checked by `check_note` (no em dash, link, contact detail or number; short).

## Human oversight

The person may edit the text; it is sent only after another person approves exactly that text. Never used for a bank mismatch.

## Limits

* General wording only, by design.
* Every call is logged in `model_calls` (prompt version and hash, model, inputs, output, tokens, cost) and fails closed: no model means a person does the step.
